name: com.quireink/blog
title: Quire Ink
description: Write, publish and steward a self-hosted Quire Ink blog: posts, front page, traffic, comments.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>, minted in the blog's admin under Settings → Connections → MCP. The token is shown once and can be revoked at any time.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The public address of your blog, e.g. https://example.com. Feeds, share cards and the MCP endpoint are all built from it.
